The '''9000 landspeeder''' was a [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian]] model [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]].<ref name="GG7 34" /> The speeder was released some decades before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="date">Because [[Feena Ghel]] is selling a [[9000 Z001 landspeeder/Legends|9000 Z001 landspeeder]] at this time, the predecessor model, the 9000, must have already been released (and discontinued) as well.</ref> The speeder's unusual design was aimed at [[Ugor/Legends|Ugor]] customers: it had a spherical shape with viewports around its hull. The vehicle ascended and hovered above its intended occupants, who then oozed underneath and up into the speeder to board. Nevertheless, sales of the unit flopped. Ubrikkian revised the design to appeal to humanoid clientele by adding seats. The new design was released as the [[9000 Z001 landspeeder/Legends|9000 Z001 landspeeder]].<ref name="GG7 34" />
